$comment: Isolated DSH test-harness settings (plugin/task-center/harness.mjs). Paths are machine-local by design (the module's default dshSource is too); DSH_TEST_HARNESS_* environment variables override every field. dshCommand is the installed DSH runtime executable (not the broken `dsh` PATH shim) driving the desktop-host CLI entry, so the harness never depends on PATH. See README 'Isolated DSH test harness' for the source-checkout alternative.
